# About this analysis

This notebook contains the L1 (Kalkbult Solar Park) analysis for the Honours
project. Supply the original CAMS file as `L1.csv` in the notebook directory.
The same methodology was applied separately at L2–L5 using their respective data.

This version was rebuilt directly from the original working file. Retained
analysis statements preserve their original text and order. Experimental
engineered-GHI calculations, preliminary bootstrap trials, redundant inspection
output and file exports have been removed. Final figures and tables are displayed
in HTML. The bootstrap functions retain their original defaults, but the final
assessment explicitly requests 1,000 repetitions.


## Packages and data preparation

```{r analysis-000, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(GGally)
library(clusterCrit)


# Versions used
R.version.string

sapply(
  c("dtwclust", "proxy", "cluster", "clusterCrit", "mclust"),
  function(pkg) as.character(packageVersion(pkg))
)
```

```{r analysis-001}
cams <- read_delim(
  "L1.csv",
  delim = ";",
  skip = 42
)

```

```{r analysis-002}
cams <- cams %>%
  separate(
    `# Observation period`,
    into = c("Start", "End"),
    sep = "/"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Start = ymd_hms(Start),
    End   = ymd_hms(End),
    Date  = as.Date(Start),
    Hour  = hour(Start),
    Month = month(Start, label = TRUE)
  )

```

```{r analysis-005}
colSums(is.na(cams))
cams %>%

cams %>%
  filter(is.na(GHI) | is.na(BHI) | is.na(DHI) | is.na(BNI)) %>%

cams %>%
  summarise(
    missing_GHI = sum(is.na(GHI)),
    missing_BHI = sum(is.na(BHI)),
    missing_DHI = sum(is.na(DHI)),
```

```{r analysis-006}
  filter(is.na(GHI) | is.na(BHI) | is.na(DHI) | is.na(BNI) | is.na(`Clear sky GHI`)) %>%
  distinct(Date)

cams_processed <- cams %>%
  filter(!Date %in% dates_with_missing$Date)

# Check the processed dataset
colSums(is.na(cams_processed))

## Check whether the fixed profile window removes any irradiance

cams_processed %>%
  filter(Hour < 4 | Hour > 19) %>%
  summarise(
    Positive_GHI_Outside = sum(GHI > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    Positive_CS_GHI_Outside = sum(`Clear sky GHI` > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_GHI_Outside = sum(GHI, na.rm = TRUE),
    Total_CS_GHI_Outside = sum(`Clear sky GHI`, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

## Exploratory analysis

```{r analysis-008}
## Positive Irradiance Distributions (i.e. excluding the 0 irradiance values)
cams_processed %>%
  filter(Hour >= 4, Hour <= 19) %>%
  select(
    GHI, BHI, DHI, BNI,
    `Clear sky GHI`,
    `Clear sky BHI`,
    `Clear sky DHI`,
    `Clear sky BNI`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 40,
    fill = "steelblue",
    colour = "white"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r analysis-010}
## Define the fixed daily irradiance analysis window
## One-hour buffer around the observed meaningful irradiance period

analysis_start <- 4
analysis_end   <- 19

# Validate this fixed window separately at every location.
# These checks do not remove observations or alter clustering inputs.
outside_window <- cams_processed %>%
  filter(Hour < analysis_start | Hour > analysis_end)

if (any(outside_window$GHI > 0 | outside_window$`Clear sky GHI` > 0)) {
  stop("Positive irradiation occurs outside the profile window. Review the window and all matching profile columns for this location.")
}

cams_processed <- cams_processed %>%
  filter(Hour >= analysis_start & Hour <= analysis_end)

profile_record_check <- cams_processed %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Records = n(),
    Unique_Hours = n_distinct(Hour),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(profile_record_check$Records != analysis_end - analysis_start + 1 |
        profile_record_check$Unique_Hours != analysis_end - analysis_start + 1)) {
  stop("Retained days must have exactly one observation for each profile hour.")
}
```

```{r analysis-011}
## Boxplots for Irradiance Outlier Detection

cams_processed %>%
  select(GHI, BHI, DHI, BNI, `Clear sky GHI`,
    `Clear sky BHI`,
    `Clear sky DHI`,
    `Clear sky BNI`) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "orange") +
  facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free") +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("")

## IQR-based outlier limits

cams_processed %>%
  select(GHI, BHI, DHI, BNI) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(value, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(value, 0.75),
    IQR = IQR(value),
    Lower = Q1 - 1.5 * IQR,
    Upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  )
```

```{r analysis-012}
## Identify potential irradiance outliers

outlier_limits <- cams_processed %>%
  select(GHI, BHI, DHI, BNI) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    Q1 = quantile(value, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(value, 0.75),
    IQR = IQR(value),
    Upper = Q3 + 1.5 * IQR
  )

```

```{r analysis-013}
## Number of IQR-based outliers by irradiance variable

cams_processed %>%
  select(GHI, BHI, DHI, BNI) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  left_join(outlier_limits, by = c("name" = "name")) %>%
  filter(value > Upper) %>%
  count(name)


## Percentage of positive observations classified as IQR outliers

cams_processed %>%
  select(GHI, BHI, DHI, BNI) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything()) %>%
  filter(value > 0) %>%
  left_join(outlier_limits, by = c("name" = "name")) %>%
  group_by(name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_positive = n(),
    potential_outliers = sum(value > Upper),
    percentage = 100 * potential_outliers / total_positive
  )

## Potential DHI outliers by hour

dhi_upper <- outlier_limits %>%
  filter(name == "DHI") %>%
  pull(Upper)

cams_processed %>%
  filter(DHI > dhi_upper) %>%
  count(Hour) %>%
  arrange(Hour)
```

```{r analysis-029}
## Sunshine duration

sunshine_duration <- cams_processed %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Sunshine_Duration = sum(`Clear sky GHI` > 0) * 60,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary(sunshine_duration$Sunshine_Duration)
range(sunshine_duration$Sunshine_Duration)

#monthly behaviour:
sunshine_duration %>%
  mutate(Month = format(Date, "%m")) %>%
  group_by(Month) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Sunshine = mean(Sunshine_Duration),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r analysis-030}
# Diagnostic only: existing data and clustering inputs remain unchanged.
diagnostic_location <- "L1"

# Matching winter and summer dates for every location.
diagnostic_dates <- as.Date(c(
  "2020-06-20", "2020-06-21", "2020-06-22",
  "2020-12-20", "2020-12-21", "2020-12-22"
))

cat("\nDAYLIGHT-PROXY DIAGNOSTIC:", diagnostic_location, "\n")

# 1. Distribution of the actual proxy across all retained days.
cat("\n1. Proxy values across all retained days\n")

diagnostic_distribution <- sunshine_duration %>%
  count(Sunshine_Duration, name = "Days") %>%
  arrange(Sunshine_Duration)

print(diagnostic_distribution, n = Inf)

# 2. Use the original hourly data to retain observations outside
#    the 04:00–20:00 window as well.
diagnostic_hourly <- cams %>%
  filter(Date %in% diagnostic_dates) %>%
  arrange(Date, Start) %>%
  mutate(
    In_Window = Hour >= analysis_start & Hour <= analysis_end,
    Positive_CS = `Clear sky GHI` > 0
  )

# Check that the selected dates have complete hourly records.
diagnostic_records <- diagnostic_hourly %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Records = n(),
    Unique_Hours = n_distinct(Hour),
    Missing_CS = sum(is.na(`Clear sky GHI`)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (nrow(diagnostic_records) != length(diagnostic_dates) ||
    any(diagnostic_records$Records != 24 |
        diagnostic_records$Unique_Hours != 24 |
        diagnostic_records$Missing_CS > 0)) {
  print(diagnostic_records)
  stop("Selected dates are missing or incomplete. Check before interpreting.")
}

# 3. Recalculate counts and compare them with the fitted feature.
diagnostic_counts <- diagnostic_hourly %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    Positive_Hours_All_Day = sum(Positive_CS),
    Positive_Hours_In_Window = sum(Positive_CS & In_Window),
    Positive_Hours_Outside = sum(Positive_CS & !In_Window),
    Recalculated_Proxy_Min = 60 * Positive_Hours_In_Window,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(sunshine_duration, by = "Date") %>%
  mutate(
    Matches_Existing = Recalculated_Proxy_Min == Sunshine_Duration
  )

cat("\n2. Counts and comparison with the existing proxy\n")
print(diagnostic_counts, n = Inf, width = Inf)

if (any(is.na(diagnostic_counts$Sunshine_Duration)) ||
    any(!diagnostic_counts$Matches_Existing, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  warning("Some selected dates are absent from the retained data or counts differ.")
}

# 4. Display hourly values around the morning and evening boundaries.
#    Full 24-hour data remain available in diagnostic_hourly.
diagnostic_boundaries <- diagnostic_hourly %>%
  filter(Hour <= 9 | Hour >= 15) %>%
  transmute(
    Date,
    Interval_Start = format(Start, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    Interval_End = format(End, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
    CS_GHI_Wh_m2 = sprintf("%.12g", `Clear sky GHI`),
    In_Window,
    Counted_In_Proxy = Positive_CS & In_Window
  )

cat("\n3. Morning and evening values; timestamps as stored in the Rmd\n")
print(diagnostic_boundaries, n = Inf, width = Inf)

# 4. Diagnostic sensitivity to small positive values.
#    These are illustrative thresholds, NOT proposed replacements
#    for the > 0 rule used in the study.
diagnostic_thresholds <- c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1)

diagnostic_sensitivity <- bind_rows(lapply(
  diagnostic_thresholds,
  function(threshold) {
    diagnostic_hourly %>%
      filter(In_Window) %>%
      group_by(Date) %>%
      summarise(
        Threshold_Wh_m2 = threshold,
        Counted_Hours = sum(`Clear sky GHI` > threshold),
        Proxy_Minutes = 60 * Counted_Hours,
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
)) %>%
  arrange(Date, Threshold_Wh_m2)

cat("\n4. Sensitivity of the count to small positive values\n")
print(diagnostic_sensitivity, n = Inf, width = Inf)
```

```{r analysis-031}
## Daily clear-sky irradiation

summary(daily_cs_area$CS_Area)
```

## Level 1 clustering

```{r analysis-032}
## Level 1 K-Means clustering

set.seed(2026)

level1_kmeans <- kmeans(
  level1_features %>%
    select(Sunshine_Duration, CS_Area),
  centers = 3,
  nstart = 25
)

level1_kmeans

#attach clusters to dates
level1_results <- level1_features %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = level1_kmeans$cluster
  )


#cluster centres
level1_kmeans$centers

#inspecting the dates
level1_results %>%
  mutate(Month = format(Date, "%m")) %>%
  count(Cluster, Month)
```

```{r analysis-033}
## Standardise Level 1 features

level1_scaled <- level1_features %>%
  select(Sunshine_Duration, CS_Area) %>%
  scale()

```

```{r analysis-037}
## Level 1 K-Means using scaled features

set.seed(2026)

level1_kmeans_scaled <- kmeans(
  level1_scaled,
  centers = 3,
  nstart = 25
)

## View scaled cluster centres
level1_kmeans_scaled$centers


## Attach cluster assignments to dates

level1_results_scaled <- level1_features %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = level1_kmeans_scaled$cluster
  )

## Cluster sizes

table(level1_results_scaled$Cluster)


## Identify clusters based on their mean Sunshine Duration and CS Area
## Lowest = Winter, middle = Transition, highest = Summer

season_score <- rowMeans(
  level1_kmeans_scaled$centers[
    , c("Sunshine_Duration", "CS_Area"),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

cluster_order <- order(season_score)

winter_cluster <- cluster_order[1]
transition_cluster <- cluster_order[2]
summer_cluster <- cluster_order[3]


## Assign seasonal labels

level1_results_scaled <- level1_results_scaled %>%
  mutate(
    Season = case_when(
      Cluster == summer_cluster ~ "Summer",
      Cluster == transition_cluster ~ "Transition",
      Cluster == winter_cluster ~ "Winter"
    ),
    Year = format(Date, "%Y"),
    Day_of_Year = as.integer(format(Date, "%j"))
  )


## Cluster sizes by season

table(level1_results_scaled$Season)


## Seasonal assignments over time

ggplot(
  level1_results_scaled,
  aes(
    x = Day_of_Year,
    y = Year,
    fill = Season
  )
) +
  geom_tile() +
  labs(
    title = "Level 1 Seasonal Assignments by Year (Scaled Features)",
    x = "Day of Year",
    y = "Year",
    fill = "Season"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


## Level 1 clustering quality metrics

level1_metrics_scaled <- intCriteria(
  as.matrix(level1_scaled),
  level1_kmeans_scaled$cluster,
  c(
    "Silhouette",
    "Calinski_Harabasz",
    "Davies_Bouldin"
  )
)

## Display metrics

data.frame(
  Silhouette = level1_metrics_scaled$silhouette,
  Calinski_Harabasz = level1_metrics_scaled$calinski_harabasz,
  Davies_Bouldin = level1_metrics_scaled$davies_bouldin
)
```


## Daily β and Level 2 clustering

```{r analysis-039}
## Daily Irradiance Index (Beta)

daily_beta <- cams_processed %>%
  filter(Hour >= 4, Hour <= 19) %>%
  group_by(Date) %>%
  summarise(
    daily_GHI = sum(GHI, na.rm = TRUE),
    daily_clear_sky_GHI = sum(`Clear sky GHI`, na.rm = TRUE),
    beta = daily_GHI / daily_clear_sky_GHI,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## Summary of Beta

summary(daily_beta$beta)

## Distribution of Beta

ggplot(daily_beta, aes(x = beta)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Daily Irradiance Index (β)",
    x = "β",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r analysis-040}
## Check β values

daily_beta %>%
  summarise(
    Beta_missing = sum(is.na(beta)),
    Beta_below_0 = sum(beta < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    Beta_above_1 = sum(beta > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    Beta_min = min(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    Beta_median = median(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    Beta_mean = mean(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    Beta_max = max(beta, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
## Check β values above 1

daily_beta %>%
  filter(beta > 1) %>%
  summarise(
    n_above_1 = n(),
    max_excess = max(beta - 1),
    mean_excess = mean(beta - 1)
  )
```

```{r analysis-041}
## Attach Level 1 season results

level2_data <- level1_results_scaled %>%
  select(Date, Season) %>%
  inner_join(
    daily_beta %>%
      select(Date, beta),
    by = "Date"
  )

```

```{r analysis-044}
## Level 2 K-Means clustering

set.seed(2026)

## Summer
summer_kmeans <- kmeans(
  level2_data %>%
    filter(Season == "Summer") %>%
    select(beta),
  centers = 3,
  nstart = 25
)


## Transition
transition_kmeans <- kmeans(
  level2_data %>%
    filter(Season == "Transition") %>%
    select(beta),
  centers = 3,
  nstart = 25
)


## Winter
winter_kmeans <- kmeans(
  level2_data %>%
    filter(Season == "Winter") %>%
    select(beta),
  centers = 3,
  nstart = 25
)

summer_kmeans$centers
transition_kmeans$centers
winter_kmeans$centers
```

```{r analysis-045}
## Assign High / Medium / Low labels
## Function to assign H/M/L labels to a seasonal K-Means result

label_kmeans <- function(kmeans_result) {
  cluster_order <- order(kmeans_result$centers[, "beta"])
  labels <- c("Low", "Medium", "High")
  setNames(
    labels,
    cluster_order
  )
}

summer_labels <- label_kmeans(summer_kmeans)
transition_labels <- label_kmeans(transition_kmeans)
winter_labels <- label_kmeans(winter_kmeans)
summer_labels
transition_labels
winter_labels
```

```{r analysis-046}
# Adding the labels to the data

level2_results <- level2_data %>%
  mutate(
    Cluster = case_when(
      Season == "Summer" ~ summer_kmeans$cluster[
        match(Date, level2_data$Date[level2_data$Season == "Summer"])
      ],
      
      Season == "Transition" ~ transition_kmeans$cluster[
        match(Date, level2_data$Date[level2_data$Season == "Transition"])
      ],
      
      Season == "Winter" ~ winter_kmeans$cluster[
        match(Date, level2_data$Date[level2_data$Season == "Winter"])
      ]
    )
  )

# Converting cluster numbers into meaningful irradiance levels

level2_results <- level2_results %>%
  mutate(
    Irradiance_Level = case_when(
      Season == "Summer" ~ unname(
        summer_labels[as.character(Cluster)]
      ),
      
      Season == "Transition" ~ unname(
        transition_labels[as.character(Cluster)]
      ),
      
      Season == "Winter" ~ unname(
        winter_labels[as.character(Cluster)]
      )
    )
  )


level2_results %>%
  count(Season, Irradiance_Level)
level2_results %>%
  group_by(Season, Irradiance_Level) %>%
  summarise(
    Min_Beta = min(beta),
    Mean_Beta = mean(beta),
    Max_Beta = max(beta),
    SD_Beta = sd(beta),
    Days = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r analysis-047}
## Level 2 clustering quality metrics

summer_metrics <- intCriteria(
  matrix(level2_data$beta[level2_data$Season == "Summer"]),
  summer_kmeans$cluster,
  c("Silhouette", "Calinski_Harabasz", "Davies_Bouldin")
)

transition_metrics <- intCriteria(
  matrix(level2_data$beta[level2_data$Season == "Transition"]),
  transition_kmeans$cluster,
  c("Silhouette", "Calinski_Harabasz", "Davies_Bouldin")
)

winter_metrics <- intCriteria(
  matrix(level2_data$beta[level2_data$Season == "Winter"]),
  winter_kmeans$cluster,
  c("Silhouette", "Calinski_Harabasz", "Davies_Bouldin")
)

level2_metrics <- data.frame(
  Season = c("Summer", "Transition", "Winter"),
  
  Silhouette = c(
    summer_metrics$silhouette,
    transition_metrics$silhouette,
    winter_metrics$silhouette
  ),
  
  Calinski_Harabasz = c(
    summer_metrics$calinski_harabasz,
    transition_metrics$calinski_harabasz,
    winter_metrics$calinski_harabasz
  ),
  
  Davies_Bouldin = c(
    summer_metrics$davies_bouldin,
    transition_metrics$davies_bouldin,
    winter_metrics$davies_bouldin
  )
)

level2_metrics
```

```{r analysis-048}
## Mean irradiance profiles for Level 2 clusters

level2_profiles <- level2_results %>%
  select(Date, Season, Irradiance_Level) %>%
  inner_join(
    daily_profiles,
    by = "Date"
  )
```

## Bootstrap stability

```{r bootstrap-package}
library(mclust)
```

```{r analysis-074}
## Function for bootstrap stability of beta clustering

bootstrap_beta_stability <- function(season_data, B = 100) {
  
  season_data <- season_data %>%
    select(
      Date,
      beta,
      Original_Cluster = Cluster
    ) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      Original_Index = row_number()
    )
  
  n <- nrow(season_data)
  
  ari_values <- numeric(B)
  
  for (b in 1:B) {
    
    # Bootstrap sample
    bootstrap_indices <- sample(
      seq_len(n),
      size = n,
      replace = TRUE
    )
    
    bootstrap_data <- season_data[
      bootstrap_indices,
    ]
    
    # Re-run beta clustering
    bootstrap_kmeans <- kmeans(
      bootstrap_data %>%
        select(beta),
      centers = 3,
      nstart = 25
    )
    
    ## Match bootstrap assignments back to original observations
    bootstrap_assignments <- data.frame(
      Original_Index = bootstrap_indices,
      Bootstrap_Cluster = bootstrap_kmeans$cluster
    )

    # Check that repeated copies of a day have the same assignment.
    assignment_check <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Original_Index) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Number_of_Assignments = dplyr::n_distinct(Bootstrap_Cluster),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    if (any(assignment_check$Number_of_Assignments != 1L)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Bootstrap replicate ", b,
          ": repeated copies of a day received different cluster assignments."
        )
      )
    }

    # Count each sampled original day only once when calculating ARI.
    bootstrap_assignments <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Original_Index, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Compare with original clustering
    bootstrap_comparison <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      left_join(
        season_data %>%
          select(
            Original_Index,
            Original_Cluster
          ),
        by = "Original_Index"
      )
    
    # Adjusted Rand Index
    ari_values[b] <- adjustedRandIndex(
      bootstrap_comparison$Original_Cluster,
      bootstrap_comparison$Bootstrap_Cluster
    )
  }
  
  return(ari_values)
}
```

```{r analysis-080}
## Function for bootstrap stability of Level 1 clustering

bootstrap_level1_stability <- function(level1_data, B = 100) {
  
  level1_data <- level1_data %>%
    select(Date, Sunshine_Duration, CS_Area, Original_Cluster) %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      Original_Index = row_number()
    )
  
  n <- nrow(level1_data)
  
  ari_values <- numeric(B)
  
  for (b in 1:B) {
    
    # Draw bootstrap sample
    bootstrap_indices <- sample(seq_len(n), size = n, replace = TRUE)
    
    bootstrap_data <- level1_data[
      bootstrap_indices,
    ]
    
    # Scale Level 1 features
    bootstrap_scaled <- scale(
      bootstrap_data %>%
        select(
          Sunshine_Duration,
          CS_Area
        )
    )
    
    # Re-run K-Means
    bootstrap_kmeans <- kmeans(
      bootstrap_scaled,
      centers = 3,
      nstart = 25
    )
    
    ## Match bootstrap assignments back to original observations
    bootstrap_assignments <- data.frame(
      Original_Index = bootstrap_indices,
      Bootstrap_Cluster = bootstrap_kmeans$cluster
    )

    # Check that repeated copies of a day have the same assignment.
    assignment_check <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Original_Index) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        Number_of_Assignments = dplyr::n_distinct(Bootstrap_Cluster),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    if (any(assignment_check$Number_of_Assignments != 1L)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Bootstrap replicate ", b,
          ": repeated copies of a day received different cluster assignments."
        )
      )
    }

    # Count each sampled original day only once when calculating ARI.
    bootstrap_assignments <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Original_Index, .keep_all = TRUE)
    
    # Join original cluster assignments
    bootstrap_comparison <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      left_join(
        level1_data %>%
          select(
            Original_Index,
            Original_Cluster
          ),
        by = "Original_Index"
      )
    
    # Calculate ARI
    ari_values[b] <- adjustedRandIndex(
      bootstrap_comparison$Original_Cluster,
      bootstrap_comparison$Bootstrap_Cluster
    )
  }
  
  return(ari_values)
}
```

```{r analysis-083}
two_level_stability <- two_level_stability %>%
  mutate(
    Original_TwoLevel_Cluster = interaction(
      Original_L1_Cluster,
      Original_L2_Cluster,
      drop = TRUE
    )

table(two_level_stability$Original_TwoLevel_Cluster)
```

```{r analysis-087}
## Function for bootstrap stability of the full two-level methodology

bootstrap_two_level_stability <- function(two_level_data, B = 100) {
  
  two_level_data <- two_level_data %>%
    arrange(Date) %>%
    mutate(
      Original_Index = row_number()
    )
  
  n <- nrow(two_level_data)
  
  ari_values <- numeric(B)
  
  for (b in 1:B) {
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Draw bootstrap sample
    
    bootstrap_indices <- sample(
      seq_len(n),
      size = n,
      replace = TRUE
    )
    
    bootstrap_data <- two_level_data[
      bootstrap_indices,
    ]
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Re-run Level 1
    
    bootstrap_scaled <- scale(
      bootstrap_data %>%
        select(
          Sunshine_Duration,
          CS_Area
        )
    )
    
    bootstrap_L1_kmeans <- kmeans(
      bootstrap_scaled,
      centers = 3,
      nstart = 25
    )
    
    bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_L1_Cluster <-
      bootstrap_L1_kmeans$cluster
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Re-run Level 2 within each new Level 1 cluster

    bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_L2_Cluster <- NA_integer_
    
    for (
      g in sort(
        unique(bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_L1_Cluster)
      )
    ) {
      
      group_indices <- which(
        bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_L1_Cluster == g
      )
      
      beta_group <- matrix(
        bootstrap_data$beta[group_indices],
        ncol = 1
      )
      
      bootstrap_L2_kmeans <- kmeans(
        beta_group,
        centers = 3,
        nstart = 25
      )
      
      bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_L2_Cluster[group_indices] <-
        bootstrap_L2_kmeans$cluster
    }
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Create final 9-group bootstrap partition
    
    bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_TwoLevel_Cluster <- interaction(
      bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_L1_Cluster,
      bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_L2_Cluster,
      drop = TRUE
    )
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Match back to original days
    
    bootstrap_assignments <- data.frame(
      Original_Index = bootstrap_indices,
      Bootstrap_TwoLevel_Cluster =
        bootstrap_data$Bootstrap_TwoLevel_Cluster
    )
    
    # Check repeated copies of a day received only one classification
    
    assignment_check <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      group_by(Original_Index) %>%
      summarise(
        Number_of_Assignments =
          n_distinct(Bootstrap_TwoLevel_Cluster),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    if (any(assignment_check$Number_of_Assignments != 1)) {
      stop("A duplicated observation received multiple bootstrap assignments.")
    }
    
    # Keep every original day only once
    bootstrap_assignments <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      distinct(
        Original_Index,
        Bootstrap_TwoLevel_Cluster
      )
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Join original partition
    
    bootstrap_comparison <- bootstrap_assignments %>%
      left_join(
        two_level_data %>%
          select(
            Original_Index,
            Original_TwoLevel_Cluster
          ),
        by = "Original_Index"
      )
    
    # -----------------------------
    # Calculate ARI
    
    ari_values[b] <- adjustedRandIndex(
      bootstrap_comparison$Original_TwoLevel_Cluster,
      bootstrap_comparison$Bootstrap_TwoLevel_Cluster
    )
  }
  
  return(ari_values)
}
```

```{r analysis-089}
  level2_results %>%

)
```

```{r analysis-092, message=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

results_location <- "L1"   # Change to L2, L3, L4 or L5 as appropriate
results_seasons <- c("Summer", "Transition", "Winter")
results_levels <- c("High", "Medium", "Low")
results_colours <- c(High = "#F8766D", Medium = "#00BA38", Low = "#619CFF")
results_season_colours <- c(Summer = "#F8766D", Transition = "#00BA38",
                           Winter = "#619CFF")

# Consistent appearance at the exported size.
results_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
  theme(plot.title = element_blank(), plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# Format a COPY for display/export. Original result objects keep their names.
results_display_table <- function(x) {
  out <- as.data.frame(x)
  if ("Method" %in% names(out)) {
    out$Method <- as.character(out$Method)
    out$Method[out$Method == "Beta"] <- "β"
  }
  if ("Representation" %in% names(out)) {
    out$Representation <- gsub("beta", "β", out$Representation, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  labels <- gsub("_", " ", names(out), fixed = TRUE)
  labels <- gsub("Beta", "β", labels, fixed = TRUE)
  names(out) <- labels
  replacements <- c(
    "Irradiance Level" = "Level",
    "Percent in Season" = "% within season",
    "Percent Days" = "% of days",
    "Mean Duration Minutes" = "Mean duration (min)",
    "Mean CS Area kWh m2" = "Mean clear-sky total (kWh/m²)",
    "Calinski Harabasz" = "Calinski–Harabasz",
    "Davies Bouldin" = "Davies–Bouldin",
    "Silhouette DTW" = "Silhouette (DTW)",
    "B" = "Replications"
  )
  for (old in names(replacements)) {
    names(out)[names(out) == old] <- replacements[[old]]
  }
  out
}

# Require the corrected DTW evaluation, rather than silently using old columns.
stopifnot(all(c(
  "Silhouette_DTW", "Silhouette_Euclidean",
  "Calinski_Harabasz_Euclidean", "Davies_Bouldin_Euclidean"
) %in% names(dtw_metrics)))
```
